claim_text: Quasi-steady nanowear rate is lowest for Al/Cu and highest for Al/Mg

steps.observation: Wear rate falls with cycles for all NMMs; at 15 cycles Al/Cu ~0.0027 < Al/Ti ~0.0035 < Al/Mg ~0.0045 um^3/cycle
steps.image_note: F3c after 10 cycles: Al/Mg track deepest (~-0.025 um) vs Al/Ti ~-0.015 and Al/Cu ~-0.01 um; F3d-f 3-D topographies

steps.support_basis: shown in the panel, entering by a qualifies edge: a caveat on the claim
steps.observation: At 2 wear cycles Al/Ti (~0.013) wears less than the harder Al/Cu (~0.018 um^3/cycle)
steps.image_note: linked text attributes the running-in deviation to the higher roughness of Al/Ti (F2d: Ra 5.49 vs 4.38 nm)

MECH.why: no shown support survives removing this channel

note: Every verdict is model against model.
